meta.title: Jujutsu (jj) support
meta.description: First-class Jujutsu (jj) support for DeepSeek Harness: repository detection, a git-confusion guard, commit-description style guidance, parallel-session jj-workspace guidance with reclaim of interrupted-session workspaces, a one-shot rebase hand-off tool, in-place correction folding for unpushed commits (jj_amend), jj-native tools, and a read-only Web panel (sidebar tab plus tool cards).
